brief:
Hundreds of demonstrators took to the streets of Berlin on Saturday to oppose the war on Gaza and express solidarity with Palestine, according to Shehab Wire. The protesters called on the German government to halt weapons exports to Israel and end its military and financial support for the occupation.

The rally underscored mounting pressure within Germany over its role in arming Israel as the conflict in Gaza continues. Demonstrators presented their opposition to both the ongoing military campaign and Berlin's decision to maintain arms supplies and aid to the Israeli government.
